evidence: The paper mentions random forest only as one of five classification methods compared for predictive performance: "Several methods for binary classification including Ridge logistic regression, LASSO logistic regression, Support vector machine (SVM), k-nearest neighbors (KNN), and random forest (RF)." No variable importance measures, feature selection methods, or impurity-based importance ranks are discussed anywhere in the paper. The study focuses entirely on classification performance estimation (accuracy, AUC, Brier score, F1-score, sensitivity, specificity) across different simulation approaches.
